gate.rule: Presence of Major Project / Thesis / Final-Year Project / Capstone Project alone is sufficient for a 'No Risk' Tier 3 outcome. Its absence routes the file to manual review even if Tier 1 and Tier 2 are otherwise strong.
gate.gateSubject: Major Project / Thesis / Final-Year Project/ Capstone Project

subjects.name: Major Project / Thesis / Final-Year Project/ Capstone Project

thresholds.label: Adequate Foundation — Low Risk
thresholds.action: Proceed to Tier 2 assessment; log the gap as an assessor note.

thresholds.label: Foundation Gap — Flag
thresholds.action: Route to manual reviewer alongside the Tier 2 outcome; do not auto-reject on Tier 1 alone.

thresholds.label: Verified — No Risk
thresholds.action: Full body-of-knowledge coverage demonstrated. Proceed to positive academic determination automatically.

thresholds.label: Verified — Low Risk
thresholds.action: Proceed to positive determination; log missing subject(s) as an assessor note, no manual hold required.

thresholds.label: Conditional — Medium Risk
thresholds.action: Route to manual reviewer with the list of matched/unmatched core subjects highlighted before a decision is issued.

thresholds.label: Not Verified — High Risk
thresholds.action: Do not auto-approve; refer for full manual academic assessment.

overallDetermination.note: Tier 3 acts as a gate (see tiers.tier3.gate), not a third numeric score, and otherwise supports the determination as evidence.

combinationTable.label: Not Verified — refer for full manual assessment

matchingPrinciples.name: Equivalent Subjects
matchingPrinciples.description: Different subject names may represent the same engineering knowledge. The naming-variant lists above are the authoritative matching source for this principle.

matchingPrinciples.name: Combined Subjects
matchingPrinciples.description: One transcript subject may satisfy multiple canonical subjects if it covers combined content (e.g. an integrated course covering both Material & Energy Balances and Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics can satisfy both).

matchingPrinciples.name: Integrated Curriculum
matchingPrinciples.description: Where sufficient engineering knowledge is demonstrated through integrated design/project-based subjects, missing standalone subjects should not be considered deficiencies.

matchingPrinciples.name: Specialised Subjects
matchingPrinciples.description: Optional/Elective subjects strengthen the qualification but are never mandatory; their absence must not reduce the risk score.

matchingPrinciples.name: Overall Knowledge Coverage
matchingPrinciples.description: Suitability is judged by overall knowledge coverage across Tier 1 and Tier 2, supported by Tier 3 evidence — not by individual subject count or a matched/total ratio.

decisionRuleNote: Do NOT calculate suitability as matched subjects ÷ total listed subjects. Universities organise curricula differently; use the tier risk-score thresholds above instead.
catchAllHandlingNote: 'Others' column variants and any transcript subject matching none of the named canonical subjects are logged for reviewer visibility but never counted toward a Tier score.
